plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 12 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.07419, -117.94691, pull off on Big Sheep Creek Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 380 m W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 8 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-9, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-duck-walk-0003.recDirections: From the junction of Highway 3B and 22, at the Le Roi Mine Museum in Rossland, travel 0.4 km south on Highway 22. Turn right onto the "Old Cascade Highway", across from the Rossland Motel. Follow this good 2 wheel drive gravel road up over Record Ridge and down into the Big Sheep Creek Valley. Just past the 22 km marker, the road forks. Turn left onto the Big Sheep Creek FSR. You will pass along farms and by cabins on the road. The sites is at 9.2 km on the left side.
R4A-duck-walk-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 4-9: about 11,050 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 9.08 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
